summary: The root قيل (qyl) in form X, اِسْتَقاَلَ, means to desire or demand the rescinding of a sale or purchase. It also refers to requesting someone to overlook or forgive a mistake or fault.
lane: 10 اِسْتَقاَلَ البَيْعَ ذ He desired, or demanded, the rescinding of the sale, or purchase. (MA.) And استقال العَنْوَةُ He desired, or demanded, his passing over, or forgiving, the slip, lapse, or fault. (MA.) See also Har, p. 7. See also a verse cited voce عَنْوَةٌ .
